findings.title: Assumption claims the README was updated in this change, but it was not
findings.why: The assumption says the README was updated in the same change and cites commit 6d36cae. The diff touches only three spec files, and `git log` shows only two commits, neither of which is 6d36cae. The README already says shipping carries no VAT in the first commit. The spec's account of how the change came about is false and its commit reference can't be traced.

findings.title: Header comment contradicts the code and FR-008
findings.why: The file header says shipping is summarised 'at the standard rate'. `vatSummary` adds shipping at rate 0, and FR-008 and the function's own comment both say rate 0.

findings.title: Total still adds a shipping VAT term that FR-004 removed
findings.why: FR-004 now defines the total as goods + shipping + VAT on goods. `totalCents` is still `goods + shipping + vat + shippingTax`, and `shippingVat` always returns 0, so the result is the same. The `shippingVatCents` field and this term are dead code that contradicts the new requirement.

findings.title: Spec status is Draft although every task is marked done
findings.why: The header says 'Status: Draft', but tasks.md marks T001 to T009 as complete. The spec's title and scope ('SKU lookup, free-shipping threshold and line VAT rounding') were not updated to cover the coupon expiry, coupon base, give-back and shipping-VAT requirements added in FR-005 to FR-008.
